difficulty_notes: Rename + signature change (argument order swap, bool -> keyword-only enum) across ~20 files. Traps: functools.partial with zone keyword (must become positional), map() argument order, getattr name string, registry key + JSON config op/args, staticmethod pricer that is a subclass extension point (must keep old signature), **body splat in a public API handler (schema must not change), similarly named calc_shipping_zone that must not be renamed, alias stacklevel, docstring mention. Each call-site file is one case: clean of the old name AND behaviour unchanged with DeprecationWarning as error.
